text: Dubai Real Estate Centre (DREC), a Dubai property company, is part of A.R.M. Holding, which describes itself as a UAE-based private investment firm.
short: Dubai Real Estate Centre is part of A.R.M. Holding.

source.name: Dubai Real Estate Centre: About us (drec.ae)
source.quote: As part of A.R.M. Holding, we consider the long-term vision and pair it with attentive service
source.note: Undated company about page. ARM Holding's own site (armholding.ae) lists 'Dubai Real Estate Centre' in its companies and says DREC 'manages over 3,200 residential and commercial units'.

additionalSources.name: A.R.M. Holding: homepage (armholding.ae)
additionalSources.quote: We are a UAE-based private investment and real estate company focused on building scalable ventures with lasting social and economic value across diverse sectors.
additionalSources.note: Undated homepage intro text; the site's footer gives a Dubai, United Arab Emirates address.
